name: Yuan Longping
summary: Chinese agronomist known for developing the first hybrid rice varieties.

name: Hunan Hybrid Rice Research Center
summary: Research center established to train rice research scientists and continue hybrid rice research.

name: Ministry of Agriculture of China
summary: Chinese government ministry responsible for agriculture policies and programs.

name: hybrid rice
summary: High-yield rice varieties created using heterosis and three-line or two-line matching methods.

name: super rice
summary: Super-high-yield hybrid rice breeding program and resulting varieties.

name: sea rice
summary: Rice variety capable of growing in saline-alkali land.

name: low cadmium-accumulating rice
summary: Rice variety engineered to block cadmium absorption.

name: China
summary: Country where Yuan Longping was born and conducted his research.

name: Hunan Province
summary: Province in China where hybrid rice yields were recorded.

name: Hengnan County
summary: County in Hunan Province where third-generation hybrid rice yield data was produced.
